dimensions.assessment: Affects all institutions of higher education participating in federal student aid programs and current and prospective college students nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: each institution of higher education that participates in a program under title IV

dimensions.assessment: Imposes administrative and compliance changes on institutions and provides detailed financial data tools for consumers.
dimensions.evidence: each institution of higher education that receives Federal funds under title IV shall make publicly available on the institution's website a net price calculator

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not specify exact dollar amounts for federal spending or revenue changes.
Amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to add new regulatory and reporting requirements for the Department of Education and educational institutions.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Higher Education Act of 1965 to increase transparency in college tuition for consumers

dimensions.assessment: Permanent changes taking effect in July 2027 and applying to award year 2027-2028 and subsequent years.
dimensions.evidence: This Act and the amendments made by this Act shall take effect on July 1, 2027

missing_information: Specific cost estimates or federal appropriations required to implement the Universal Net Price Calculator and website updates.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes new federal requirements for college financial transparency, mandating updates to the College Scorecard website, creation of a Universal Net Price Calculator, and implementation of institution-level calculators for all colleges participating in federal student aid programs.
